$comment: BUSINESS IDENTITY CONFIGURATION — read before editing.
Every field below is rendered verbatim on the public website. Nothing here may be
guessed, approximated, or filled in with example data. `npm run build` runs
scripts/validate-config.mjs, which refuses to build when a value looks like a
placeholder or when a value is present but has not been marked verified.
TO ADD A FIELD: put the real value in `value`, then set `verified` to true.
TO OMIT A FIELD: leave `value` as null. The website simply will not render it.
Omitting is always safe. Inventing is never safe.
tagline: An independent editorial resource on American classic car restoration

email.source: Provided directly by the site owner.

legalName.source: Not independently verified. Enter the registered legal entity name if one exists.

phone.source: Not independently verified. Enter a real, monitored business line only.

address.source: Not independently verified. Enter a real business address only — never a residential or approximated one.

businessHours.source: Not independently verified. Enter real staffed hours only.

responseTime.source: Not independently verified. Only state a response window you can actually meet.

social.$comment: Add only profiles that genuinely exist and are controlled by this business.

$organizationTypeNote: Kept as the generic schema.org Organization type. Do not upgrade to LocalBusiness or AutoRepair until a verified physical address and real service operation exist — those types assert a physical place of business to search engines.
